enableNRRForInboundDecodedMessages.description: The value indicating whether to enable NRR for inbound decoded messages.

enableNRRForInboundEncodedMessages.description: The value indicating whether to enable NRR for inbound encoded messages.

enableNRRForInboundMDN.description: The value indicating whether to enable NRR for inbound MDN.

enableNRRForOutboundDecodedMessages.description: The value indicating whether to enable NRR for outbound decoded messages.

enableNRRForOutboundEncodedMessages.description: The value indicating whether to enable NRR for outbound encoded messages.

enableNRRForOutboundMDN.description: The value indicating whether to enable NRR for outbound MDN.

encryptionCertificateName.description: The name of the encryption certificate.

overrideGroupSigningCertificate.description: The value indicating whether to send or request a MDN.

sha2AlgorithmFormat.description: The Sha2 algorithm format. Valid values are Sha2, ShaHashSize, ShaHyphenHashSize, Sha2UnderscoreHashSize.

signingCertificateName.description: The name of the signing certificate.
